home:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production visual reference for a first-person Three.js scene in the project "feels"; a finished full-frame landscape ink illustration, approximately 3:2.
Primary request: What it feels like to sit at home with a hot drink while rain falls outside. The viewer IS seated in the chair, looking out through their own eyes, not looking at a dollhouse or a room from above.
Composition: natural seated eye height, a generous rain-dark window filling the left-middle of the view, a modest round wooden side table within arm's reach at lower right, with a steaming handmade ceramic mug and a closed paperback; a sleeping cat curled low at the left edge; a curved reading lamp makes a pool of light; a few books and one simple trailing plant at the right edge. The scene continues beyond all four edges; cropped foreground objects establish intimate scale. No visible viewer, hands, or body. Room perspective should be physically believable and easy to reconstruct in 3D.
Style: sophisticated mid-century black-and-white literary-magazine cartoon illustration. Confident irregular nib-pen contours, varied line weight, graceful simplification, expressive silhouette, loosely placed short hatching strokes only in shadows. Not a CAD drawing and not a technical etching. Leave generous areas of untouched white paper. Carefully balanced large blacks, not uniform parallel stripes across every surface.
Mood: quiet, sheltered, slightly melancholic; the dark wet world outside contrasts with the still room. Rain streaks on the glass, a few dim silhouettes of rooftops beyond. Warmth conveyed through composition, without color.
Palette: only black ink and clean white paper; no beige, no colored light, no gray wash, no photorealism.
Avoid: any typography, captions, borders, UI, labels, collage, split panels, isometric view, exterior dollhouse view, excessive clutter, repetitive machine hatching, glossy 3D render.
paris:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production visual reference for a first-person Three.js Paris café scene, full-frame landscape approximately 3:2.
Primary request: the feeling of lingering at a tiny Paris sidewalk café table, seen through the seated visitor's own eyes. Natural human seated perspective, no visible viewer, no dollhouse.
Composition: a cropped round bistro tabletop fills the lower third, a small espresso cup and saucer near its center-left, a properly crescent-shaped flaky croissant on a small plate at lower right, folded newspaper without legible text at lower left. One graceful bentwood woven café chair to the side. Overhead a black-and-white striped awning clips the upper edge. Beyond the table a quiet narrow street recedes obliquely toward the right, with a row of varied Parisian limestone facades, shuttered windows, delicate iron balconies, a bookstore frontage, a bicycle, one plane tree and a few small relaxed pedestrians. Foreground objects large enough to feel within reach. More detailed silhouettes in the foreground, much simpler line work in the distance.
Style: a sophisticated mid-century black-and-white literary-magazine cartoon drawn by hand with a nib pen. Loose, selective crosshatching, varied expressive contour weights, large unmarked white areas, bold black accents in shopfronts and the awning; avoid mechanical repeating stripes on surfaces. Warm, calm, slightly wistful, observational.
Palette: STRICTLY BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE PAPER. Absolutely no cream tint, sepia, color, charcoal-gray wash or smooth shading. Texture comes only from discrete ink strokes and stipple.
Constraints: elegant, physically plausible architecture and furniture, fully immersive first-person viewpoint, natural perspective, no text labels, captions, border, UI, collage, split panels, photorealism, isometric view or glossy computer rendering.
purpose: Visual references for fully modeled Three.js studies in the main edition, and source artwork for the separate illustrated relief/parallax edition.
